@Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.actual_exchange_reference : ∀ {R : Type}
  {leavesA leavesB : Qleisli.HierarchicalFiniteEvaluation.Leaves Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.Operator}
  {artifactA artifactB : QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Artifact} {a b : Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.Spine}
  {N n m ka la kb lb : Nat} (p : Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.Premises leavesA artifactA a N n m ka la)
  (q : Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.Premises leavesB artifactB b N m n kb lb) (r : Nat)
  (frames : Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.Frames p q r),
  Eq.{1} (Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.matrixAt n n (Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.Premises.U p))
      (Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.matrixAt n n (Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.Premises.V q)) →
    Eq.{1} (Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.matrixAt m m (Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.Premises.V p))
        (Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.matrixAt m m (Qleisli.RoutedControlCommutation.Premises.U q)) →
      ∀ (fuelA fuelB : Nat) (actualA actualB : Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.Operator),
        Eq.{1}
            (Qleisli.HierarchicalFiniteEvaluation.physical Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.algebra leavesA artifactA fuelA
              (QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Entry.implementation
                (QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Artifact.entry artifactA)))
            (Option.some.{0} actualA) →
          Eq.{1}
              (Qleisli.HierarchicalFiniteEvaluation.physical Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.algebra leavesB artifactB
                fuelB
                (QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Entry.implementation
                  (QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Artifact.Artifact.entry artifactB)))
              (Option.some.{0} actualB) →
            ∀ (ψ : Qleisli.CoordinateOperators.Bits N → R → Complex) (output : Qleisli.CoordinateOperators.Bits N)
              (reference : R),
              Eq.{1}
                (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.matrixAt N N actualA)
                  (fun input => ψ input reference) output)
                (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (Qleisli.HierarchicalOperators.matrixAt N N actualB)
                  (fun input => ψ input reference) output)
